---
name: markdown-tidy
description: Formats markdown files consistently (headings, lists, code fences, trailing whitespace).
---

# Markdown tidy

When the user asks you to clean up a markdown file:

1. Use ATX headings (`#`) with one space after the hashes.
2. Use `-` for unordered lists and indent nested lists by two spaces.
3. Put a language tag on every fenced code block.
4. Remove trailing whitespace and end the file with a single newline.

Only change formatting. Never change the meaning of the text.
